name: @muse/design-system
description: Canonical M.U.S.E. 'Singularity' design tokens. The single source of craft shared by the web cockpit and the Android app. White core in the void, one thin spectral ring.
source: Derived from gateway/cockpit/static/tokens.css and docs/brand/muse-design-language.md. When the two disagree, the design-language doc wins.

void.comment: background — the dark field, full-bleed always

void-2.comment: raised surface (tonal elevation, not a shadow)

core.comment: the single point of light — primary accent / hero

ok.comment: success / online (UI status — never in brand art)

warn.comment: attention (UI status — never in brand art)

danger.comment: destructive / emergency stop (UI status — never in brand art)

ring.comment: the spectral ring gradient — left→right cyan→violet

spacing.comment: 4/8 grid. Use these for padding, gaps, and inset.

radius.comment: md (12) is the canonical default — matches --radius in tokens.css

type.comment: px sizes; weights are CSS numeric weights; letterSpacing in px.

font.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

elevation.comment: Tonal overlays, NOT drop shadows (a brand Don't). Higher elevation = lighter void tone.

motion.comment: Material 3 motion. Durations in ms, easing as cubic-bezier curves.

glyph.comment: The mark geometry, normalized so apps can reconstruct it at any size. Ratios are relative to the viewBox dimension. Canonical reference: gateway/cockpit/static/index.html header svg (viewBox 48).
